clues: This town lies in the southwest of Argentina. Green valleys run through the Andes mountains near it.
Valleys cut through the Andes toward the Pacific Ocean. They help keep this far south town oddly mild.
The first farmers from Chile came here in 1885. Lucas Cárdenas and Elcira Estrada made their home in this valley.
In the 1970s, hippies came here from Buenos Aires. Some grew garden plants and made crafts by hand.
Look for the town at the foot of Piltriquitron Mountain. That one peak marks this place in southwest Argentina.
